info.title: CodebaseExplorer
info.description: AI-powered codebase profiler that generates structured knowledgebases as markdown documentation from source code analysis.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: AI-powered codebase profiler that generates structured knowledgebases as markdown documentation

options.name: --output
options.description: Output directory for knowledgebase documents (defaults to <path>/.knowledgebase)

options.name: --depth
options.description: Maximum directory tree depth for scanning [default: 3]

options.name: --insecure
options.description: Disable SSL/TLS certificate validation (for enterprise proxies with self-signed certificates) [default: False]

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: Root directory of the codebase to analyze
